WHY_ME.TITLE: Why me
WHY_ME.TEXT: I am curious, creative and solution-oriented. New technologies inspire me just as much as good design. I love questioning processes, thinking through problems and developing my own solutions that not only work but also feel good. My goal: To be able to implement websites on the level of studios like Buttermax on my own.
WHY_ME.SUBTITLE: I am

SKILLS.TITLE: My Skill Set
SKILLS.TEXT: In over 12 projects – including a task management app like Join – I have learned to apply various frontend technologies in practice and combine them effectively. Discovering new tools and frameworks drives me. Next up: React.
SKILLS.SUBTEXT: I actively follow the frontend scene, document my knowledge, and teach myself new solutions independently – such as the horizontal scrolling for this portfolio, which went beyond the scope of my training.

PROJECTS.TITLE: My Work
PROJECTS.JOIN_DESCRIPTION: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
PROJECTS.JOIN_LEARNING: Through this project, I learned how to build a complex application with drag-and-drop functionality and state management.
PROJECTS.POLLO_DESCRIPTION: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
PROJECTS.POLLO_LEARNING: Through this project, I learned how to implement object-oriented programming in JavaScript and create a game loop.
PROJECTS.POKEDEX_DESCRIPTION: Based on the PokéAPI. An app to search and display Pokémon information.
PROJECTS.POKEDEX_LEARNING: Through this project, I learned how to integrate complex APIs and filter data efficiently.
